scenario: Early delinquency (~10 DPD); borrower hesitates, cites salary date, then makes a firm full-EMI PTP aligned to salary; read-back confirmed
intended_agent_behavior: Verify identity before disclosure; name org; state overdue EMI; ask; accommodate salary date; capture date+amount; read back; obtain explicit confirmation; state next step

judge_bait: Hedge-then-firm: an early non-committal filler must not make the final commitment 'soft' (firmness judged at the commitment span)
